keyFindings.description: note() changes nothing for a room already waiting in the heap. A room a quiet check parked until its 15-minute mark collects any number of rows older than 2 minutes before its check, so the drained-queue bound the PR body states in place of acceptance 6's 1.25x condition (fewer than 16 older rows) fails during a burst that starts after that check. Pull a waiting entry forward to firstCheck on a note, as settle already does for a room in flight.
compactionSweepTick has no production caller after the move to duty.RunLeased; only tests call it. Move it into the test file.
Lines 68-70 and 81 cite the daily compaction and lease document-compaction as a loop that must not tick at start; this PR removes it and runs document-compaction with TickAtStart.
bufferedFolds = 4 claims to equal store's roomsPoolSize, tied only by a comment (also AGENTS.md); state the bound on its own terms or derive it.
The comment calls the hourly sweep a pass over every document; it reads only the documents doc_compaction_owed names.

notDefects: compactionTry/compactionAttempt between tryCompaction and compactionStep: tryCompaction is the one mapping round 1 asked for; the step's translation is a short, readable switch.

A load waiting for a fold slot holds its rooms-pool connection idle in its transaction: latency only, no deadlock (a slot holder waits on no connection or lock), and no worse than main, where every load folded on a rooms-pool connection. Recorded in the PR body's risks.
The 2-minute tail measured on created_at (the inserting transaction's start): bounded by the transaction's length, recorded as not proven in the PR body.
